name: Article 9, § 1, point d – 143
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on applying a generalised scheme of tariff preferences and repealing Regulation (EU) No 978/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text: (d) it gives a binding undertaking to maintain ratification of the core human and labour rights conventions and to ensure the effective implementation of those core conventions, accompanied by a plan of action for the effective implementation of the relevant conventions;
